fusions.name: Edge Along the Shaft
fusions.desc: A drawing cut that deals 7 slashing damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Out of the Sleeve
fusions.desc: A flick throw that deals 18 slashing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sleeved Away
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 15% while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Always Closer
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
